items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: Well, he, lots of times he'd come sit on in with Buddy's band, you know, with two Kranichs, you know what I mean?

ctx.x: Well, he was a pretty nice Kranich player, he was nice. Well, he, lots of times he'd come sit on in with Buddy's band, you know, with two Kranichs, you know what I mean? Just to get the swing of the music, you know? So after he got the swing, lots of times that Edmund Hall didn't feel like working, so he'd tell him to go in and make them jobs, you know? So he made a couple of jobs with Buddy, but he was a nice fellow.
Can you tell me anything about what he played like, or who he sounded like?
